maddeler.e:
اقتصروا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَصَرُوا (iqtaṣarū) /iq.ta.sˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# اُقْتُصِرُوا (uqtuṣirū) /uq.tu.sˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# اِقْتَصِرُوا (iqtaṣirū) /iq.ta.sˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
